def find_target_size(model_name):

	target_sizes = {
		"VGG-Face": (224, 224),
		"Facenet": (160, 160),
		"Facenet512": (160, 160),
		"OpenFace": (96, 96),
		"DeepFace": (152, 152),
		"DeepID": (47, 55), # Swapped the values
		"Dlib": (150, 150),
		"ArcFace": (112, 112),
		"SFace": (112, 112)
	}

	if model_name not in target_sizes.keys():
		raise ValueError(f"unimplemented model name - {model_name}")

	return target_sizes[model_name]
